title: AI team — agent configuration (MAT-16)
description: CLI-based agent configuration for multi-agent orchestration. Defines which CLI tools handle which roles — no API keys required.

agents.description: Map of agent roles and/or agent names to CLI tool configurations (runtime merges role then name). At least one entry required.

schema_version.description: Bump only when the config document shape changes.

cli_tool.description: CLI tool identifier. codex-review is review-only Codex (distinct from codex). 'custom' requires explicit command configuration.

command.description: Custom command to invoke (required when cli is 'custom', optional override otherwise).

capabilities.description: Capabilities this agent provides. Used for routing decisions.

flags.description: Default CLI flags passed to every invocation of this agent.

working_dir.description: Working directory for this agent (defaults to repo_root from request).

timeout_ms.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for this agent (1s–1h).

enabled.description: Set false to disable this agent without removing config.

invocation_mode.description: Dispatch via CLI subprocess (default) or direct provider API.

provider.description: API provider registry key when invocation_mode is 'api' (e.g. claude, openai, gemini). Defaults from cli binding.

model.description: Model id for API invocations when invocation_mode is 'api'.

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens for API invocations.

max_retries.description: Retry count for transient CLI/API infrastructure failures (MAT-98).

backoff_ms.description: Initial exponential-backoff delay in milliseconds before the first retry (MAT-98).

backoff_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to backoff_ms after each retry (MAT-98).

circuit_breaker.description: MAT-98 in-process circuit breaker settings for CLI/API invocations.

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive infrastructure failures that open the breaker.

cooldown_ms.description: Time in the open state before transitioning to half-open.

spend_rate_window_ms.description: Rolling window for spend-rate spike detection.

spend_rate_token_limit.description: If tokens consumed in the window exceed this limit, open the breaker.

capability.description: Agent capability used for automatic routing.

routing.description: Optional explicit routing rules. Maps operation patterns to agent roles.

codex_ops.description: Agent role for codex.* operations (implement, test, refactor, diagnose, review).

git_ops.description: Agent role for git.* operations (status, fetch, pull, push, etc.).

planning.description: Agent role for planning and decomposition tasks.

research.description: Agent role for research and information gathering.

defaults.description: Default settings applied across all agents.

max_retries.description: Default retry count for transient failures (MAT-98).

backoff_ms.description: Default initial exponential-backoff delay in milliseconds (MAT-98).

backoff_multiplier.description: Default backoff multiplier after each retry (MAT-98).

working_dir_env.description: Env var name to read default working directory from.

invocation_mode.description: Default dispatch mode for all agents (cli or direct API).

max_tokens.description: Default max completion tokens for API invocations.
